title: What people frame, iv
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: A death certificate. Gully's uncle's. Gully brings it. Wood cuts the mat with the dog on his foot.

panels.composition: The frame shop counter. GULLY in his regular clothes, no apron, holding a folded certificate. WOOD.

characters.pose: holding a folded document, no cap

image.prompt: a young man without his usual cap standing at a frame-shop counter holding a folded document, the clerk looking at him, brush-pen black and white
image.notes: Gully without the cap. The only time in the run until 2014.

panels.composition: The document on the counter, unfolded a quarter-inch: an official seal. The strip does not show the words.
props: a document with an official seal, mostly folded

image.prompt: close-up of an official document unfolded only a quarter inch on a counter, a seal visible, the words hidden

panels.composition: Wood choosing a frame without asking. Cedar. Plain. The same as the fishing license.

characters.pose: taking down a plain cedar frame

image.prompt: a young man taking a plain cedar frame down from a wall of frames while his friend watches

panels.composition: The two of them on the spackle buckets in the alley. No clams. Rain. Barnaby's chin on Gully's boot this time.

image.prompt: two young men sitting on spackle buckets in a rain alley with no food, a small dog resting its chin on one man's boot, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: The uncle dies off the page, in February 2001. The shack is Gully's. Nobody says either thing.
